description: The seller's own listings - the same list Your Listings shows - with each one's status (Active; In review; Reserved; Sold; Inactive, which seller_relist_listing can bring back; Removed, taken down by the seller, shown only with include_removed and never back), pricing_basis (take_home: seller_update_listing's price_usd sets take_home_usd; asking_price, older listings: it sets asking_usd, null on one lifted to its floor), take_home_usd, buyer_price_usd, the transaction and pickup fees, and link. Removed listings are left out unless include_removed is true. Drafts saved without photos are not listings yet; they are returned separately in drafts_awaiting_photos, each with its finish link. A draft only ever lacks photos: with one, a listing publishes.

include_removed.description: Include listings the seller took down, shown with status Removed (default false). A removed listing cannot come back.

name: seller_list_listings
title: My listings
